title: The normalized translated Schur rows stay below the displayed bound (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, divide each Schur row on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` by its diagonal. Every off-diagonal row sum is strictly below `exp(-2 a theta)+5 exp(-2 a)`.
- Vertices 0 and 9 have diagonal exactly 1 and identically zero Schur correction, so the original exponent majorant still bounds those rows. The quotients at 1, 2, 7, and 8 use the enclosed off-sums divided by diagonal lower bounds from the corrections in `(1/10^99, 1/10^98)` and `(1/10^25, 1/10^24)`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized Schur section, not a proof of the note's all-size row gap.
